scope_out: real file storage, OCR, or virus scanning; editing an application after submission

operations.text:
- Step 1: write acceptance tests first in specs/test_artefacts/acceptance/test_e2_s3_documents.py (AC1-AC5), run record-at-red.js while red; API tests in backend/tests/api/test_documents.py
- Step 2: extend backend/src/truelend/repository/documents_repo.py (mark_uploaded by application and type, setting status UPLOADED, filename and clearing reason) and backend/src/truelend/repository/applications_repo.py (mark_submitted with policy_version and submitted_at); no file content is stored
- Step 3: add backend/src/truelend/service/document_service.py (upload_document: owner check returns not-found for non-owners, 422 DOCUMENT_TYPE_NOT_REQUIRED when type not in checklist, REJECTED re-upload resets to UPLOADED; submit_application: 409 ALREADY_SUBMITTED, 409 MISSING_DOCUMENTS listing missing types, pins the active policy version via policy_service, one transaction (SG-8))
- Step 4: add the document routes to backend/src/truelend/api/applications_router.py (owner-only POST /{id}/documents returning 201, POST /{id}/submit returning 200) and add DOCUMENT_TYPE_NOT_REQUIRED, MISSING_DOCUMENTS and ALREADY_SUBMITTED error codes in backend/src/truelend/types/errors.py; register nothing new in backend/src/truelend/api/main.py unless a new router is created
